title: ProjectE L3 physical-acceptance gate receipt
description: Emitted by tools/scripts/lab/physical_measurement.py alongside physical_measurement_manifest.json. It is DELIBERATELY NOT a gate-receipt/v1: that envelope is the design-time L1 quality gate, whose parsed_metrics leaves are numbers a script derived from artifacts. This receipt answers a different question on a different loop - is there valid PHYSICAL evidence for the required D rows of one accepted unit, and which side of the supplied limit is it on. Conflating them would let a GREEN artifact gate and a GREEN bench campaign occupy the same field, which is exactly the gap this skill was written to close.

verdict.$comment: The closed vocabulary only. No new verdict is introduced here, and no pre-compliance result reaches GREEN.

signoff.description: This gate closes evidence sufficiency, not certification. An accredited-lab row still needs the accredited lab's own artifact; without it the row is CONFIRM.

manifest.$comment: The receipt is a summary; the manifest is the evidence. A receipt whose manifest digest is null was not written to disk, so nothing downstream can re-read what it summarised.

evidence_origin.$comment: Mandatory. coverage-gate.md: a skill that does not publish PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT cannot close an L3 row even while listing L3 in assurance_loop.

domain_state.$comment: The serial campaign stage reached. Separate from verdict on purpose; verdict is the binding field.

feedback_actions.$comment: How many L2 edges l3_feedback_actions.json carries. Non-zero with verdict GREEN is impossible: an edge is only opened for a row this gate could not close.
